note: Site lists only 'EMH' (5x56) for the standalone 'RoMa Craft Aquitaine' line. Aquitaine is a distinct sub-blend from core CroMagnon - Ecuador Habano Ligero wrapper over Cameroon binder and Nicaraguan filler (vs. CroMagnon's Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper) - both Mac photos are this Aquitaine blend, originally filed in a 'Cromagnon' subfolder but the vitola names match Aquitaine-specific naming (cave/prehistoric-anthropology theme), not plain CroMagnon. FLAG: Aquitaine also has its own vitola called 'Knuckle Dragger' distinct in name from - but sharing a name with - the site's existing plain CroMagnon 'Knuckle Dragger' (4x52) entry. Recommend visually confirming wrapper color (darker Habano Ligero vs. Broadleaf) before merging or treating as separate database entries.

additional_vitolas.name: Knuckle Dragger
additional_vitolas.notes: Same name and size as the site's existing plain CroMagnon 'Knuckle Dragger' - but this is the Aquitaine sub-blend, a different wrapper. Possible duplicate-name situation, not a duplicate product.
